name: uibc-core
description: Reference implementation of UIBC (Uniform Identity-Behavior Chain): verifiable evidence packages for autonomous AI agents, built on the LGD principles of Registry, Evidence and Gates. Every agent action can be sealed into a submission.uibc package (identity + lifecycle events + content-hashed evidence + evidence root + optional seal), then verified offline. Status: PROPOSAL, not a formal standard. Verification results are scoped proofs, not absolute trust claims.
